channel.title: Voice of Startup Bangladesh
channel.description: Verified Bangladesh startup, business and investment news

item.title: Two friends are making cars after leaving their jobs
item.description: Two friends started business with only 30 lakh taka capital. Masuduzzaman Khan and Rashed Nasser. The company received more than one crore work orders last year.

item.title: 9 industry groups in the billion dollar club, who's on the list
item.description: The fiscal year 2025-26 was not very comfortable for the industrial sector of the country. Factory production has been hampered by fuel shortage, and there has been no significant growth in exports.

item.title: Beco wants to expand business in Bangladesh
item.description: Beco, a subsidiary of Turkey's Koch Group, has pledged to continue investing in expanding production capacity and business expansion in Bangladesh.

item.title: Touhid's products made of pineapple, banana, jute yarn are going to 39 countries
item.description: Entrepreneur Towhid bin Abdus Salam has built six factories to manufacture eco-friendly home furnishing products. 4 thousand 700 workers are working in the company which started with only 14 lakh taka and one worker.

item.title: The story of an engineer becoming a businessman
item.description: He passed from Bangladesh University of Engineering (BUET) in 1977. The subject was Civil Engineering. It was relatively easy to get jobs for engineers then. There were even opportunities to work outside the country.

item.title: Business started with 30 thousand taka, now export is 28 crore taka
item.description: Year 1993 After passing high school, Syed Muhammad Shoaib Hashan was admitted to Chittagong College with Honors in Chemistry. Besides, he started a poultry farm with 500 chickens on the roof of his house in Patharghata. Capital 30 thousand taka.

item.title: Nvidia CEO admits affair with Chinese 'spy', investigation begins
item.description: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has admitted to having an extramarital affair with a Chinese female spy suspected of being a US intelligence agency.

item.title: Dolly is a successful entrepreneur who quit her job in a foreign company
item.description: Kya Chin Thay (Dolly) left the post of country director of the world famous American company MGF Sourcing and started the buying house business. The time is November 2019. A few workers are also appointed.

item.title: The government wants to make a Bengali model of AI, talks with four institutions
item.description: The government is planning to create its own model of artificial intelligence (AI) in Bengali. For this, the country wants to build a strong computer and server infrastructure.

item.title: Zahidul returned to the United States and is now a successful agricultural entrepreneur
item.description: After spending almost a century and a half abroad, he returned to the country and established himself as an agricultural entrepreneur. Zahidul Islam. Originally, his venture started with the idea of ​​unadulterated crops, later it took a commercial form.

item.title: Sahabuddin, an engineer in the sugarcane business, left his job
item.description: He has cultivated sugarcane on 100 bighas of land in that area through contract farming. Due to his initiative, Amrit variety sugarcane is becoming popular in the area.

item.title: Nazma Akhter earns lakhs of taka per month by making fish chips
item.description: Many people started online business at the beginning of Corona. He also made a profit. From that idea, in 2020, entrepreneur Nazma Akhter started an online business of girls' beauty products.

item.title: Need 20 lakhs, bank wants to give 5 lakhs, entrepreneurs are not getting loans as per demand
item.description: Hatbox, a souvenir manufacturing small and medium enterprise (SME), applies for a CC loan (business management loan) of Tk 20 lakh from a private bank. But the bank doesn't want to give more than Tk 4-5 lakh loan.

item.title: When an AI Summit Becomes an API Summit
item.description: Bangladesh's first national AI business summit, held in Dhaka on 5 November, was billed as a step towards a technology-driven economy.

item.title: Bangladeshi Moin's successful startup dreams in Canada
item.description: The time is 2000. Mohammad Moin, a boy from Shyamnagar village of Sunamganj, was preparing to go abroad for higher education after completing his studies at Sylhet Cadet College. At that time, Shamsul Islam's father, a school teacher, was diagnosed with cancer.

item.title: 90 thousand MSME entrepreneurs have received cyber security training
item.description: Asia Foundation and Sajeda Foundation have conducted nationwide training programs to raise awareness about cyber security.

item.title: Sawada of Magura made and exported toys made of felna
item.description: Ekonjre Bold Partners Limited started its journey in 2018. So far the export of goods is about 34 crore rupees. 400 types of pet products are made from papaya tube, mango and neem stalks, sedge leaves and grass.

item.title: Buy a flat or invest elsewhere
item.description: Jobber AKM Azhar has booked a flat in Bachila of the capital. He does not have a very high paying job. He is the only earner in the family. His family with wife and two children.

item.title: 5 types of punishment including disconnection of gas and electricity for non-payment of income tax return
item.description: You have not filed income tax return. Think what will happen to you. If the tax officials are strict, the fine can be up to 50 thousand rupees. Even the gas-electricity connection may be cut off.

item.title: Household expenses are increasing, how to save savings
item.description: In 2021, Azhar Hossain (pseudonym) lived on 50 thousand taka per month. Apart from this, some money was also in hand. He used to save that money. But in the last few years, the cost of daily necessities, house rent, children's education and transportation have increased.

item.title: Loan transfer facility at BRAC Bank at 9 percent interest, no additional cost
item.description: BRAC Bank has announced the purchase (takeover) of personal loans (personal loans) and housing loans (home loans) in any bank or financial institution at low interest. Under this special offer, customers will have to pay 9 percent interest in the first year.

item.title: Why did the speed of transactions in Bangla QR stopped?
item.description: The 'Bangla QR' initiative launched to popularize digital transactions by reducing the use of cash has largely stalled. Initially, the transaction speed was promising but in recent times it has declined.

item.title: Dental hygienist-turned-artist, Florida-based entrepreneur Jahan Rima from Sandeep
item.description: Bangladesh girl Masuma Jahan Rima. A dental hygienist in the US by profession. Revealed himself as a writer more than an era ago.

item.title: Why are the sellers in trouble with the 5 crore rupees in Cox's Bazar?
item.description: There are at least 45 shops in Cox's Bazar's Nazirertech Shuntki Bazaar. In the shops, there are various types of knives including knives, laitya, maitya, popa, surma.

item.title: He is now a successful entrepreneur from his addiction to reading books
item.description: He was addicted to reading books since he was in college and university. To buy books other than textbooks. Abdul Gani used to spend more money. From this interest in reading books, he developed a friendship with the owner of a bookstore in Rajshahi.

item.title: How Shaheen Reza changed his fortune by exporting hair
item.description: The son of the remote village of Jhenaidah has changed his fortune by selling the discarded hair of people's heads. Shaheen Reza In his youth, his dream was to study in Dhaka University, then do business.

item.title: Cricketer-turned-successful entrepreneur Ziaul Haque
item.description: Once used to play cricket regularly. But he had to leave the game due to injury. But could not move away from cricket. After leaving the game of cricket, he has now built a factory for manufacturing cricket equipment. Ziaul Haque.

item.title: From grocery store worker to successful entrepreneur
item.description: Village Rouha is 20 km from Sherpur Sadar. The village is surrounded by green paddies. An orchard suddenly catches the eye in the green paddy field, there is also a ceremony of green.
